crossRefs.note: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water!
and it happen, when he hears the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, “I shall have peace…
“How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools…
For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.
